name: config-error-with-secret

sections.label: secret
sections.content:
apiVersion: v1
kind: Secret
metadata:
  name: database
  namespace: shop
data:
  DB_PASSWORD: ZXZhbC1vbmx5LXNlY3JldC03aDNr
stringData:
  password: eval-only-secret-7h3k

sections.label: events
sections.content: Warning Failed: could not find key DATABASE_PASSWORD in Secret shop/database

scripted_reply:
CreateContainerConfigError is caused by a missing key: the pod references DATABASE_PASSWORD but the Secret exposes DB_PASSWORD. Correct the reference; do not copy secret values into the manifest.
```yaml
apiVersion: apps/v1
kind: Deployment
metadata:
  name: api
  namespace: shop
spec:
  template:
    spec:
      containers:
      - name: app
        env:
        - name: DATABASE_PASSWORD
          valueFrom:
            secretKeyRef:
              name: database
              key: DB_PASSWORD
```
```sh
kubectl -n shop describe pod api-111
```
